definitions.supplemental: l. friþ-mál. The word seems Scandinavian. Cf. Icel. mál a stipulation, an agreement; frið-mál; pl. words of peace; friðmælask to sue for peace.

source_text: friþ-mǽl, -mál. l. friþ-mál. The word seems Scandinavian. Cf. Icel. mál a stipulation, an agreement; frið-mál; pl. words of peace; friðmælask to sue for peace.
